content:
Join RossoWin Casino and explore thousands of slots, live dealer tables and sports betting, all with one shared balance. Start with popular titles from leading studios, try the latest releases or join our €1,000,000 jackpot promotion.

We've got regular tournaments, Buy Bonus slots and Early Payout for sports betting. Create your account, choose your favourite games and discover more ways to play at RossoWin.

Games at RossoWin Casino From Classic Slots to Live Shows

Finding your next game is easy. Head to New for the latest releases, Top for standout titles or Popular to see which games are attracting the most players. Dedicated Jackpot and Buy Bonus categories take you straight to your preferred features.

Slots With Popular Features and New Releases

Start with Fruit Million or Luck of Panda Bonus Combo, try the high-volatility Wanted Dead or a Wild, or explore Asian-themed favourites such as Fortune Tiger and Mahjong Ways 2. We bring together traditional slots and modern releases featuring special symbols, multipliers and bonus rounds.

Don't want to wait for scatters to land? Visit Buy Bonus to purchase access to a bonus round straight away. Try 3 Hot Chillies, Diamond of Jungle or other slots with this feature. The purchase price depends on the individual game, while Bonus Friendly offers more titles featuring bonus mechanics.

Our Jackpot section includes Jackpot Raiders, Ocean King Jackpot, Frost Queen Jackpots and other jackpot slots. We also run a separate promotion with a €1,000,000 prize pool. Entry requirements and prize distribution are subject to the promotion's terms.

Live Casino With Real Dealers

Our Live Casino brings you real dealers and presenters through live streams. Choose Live Roulette, join the card tables or explore interactive game shows. Live chat and studio broadcasts bring the atmosphere of a real casino straight to your screen.

Stay at your favourite table or switch between different formats whenever you like. Betting limits vary by game, with options for smaller stakes as well as tables with higher limits.

Table and Card Games

Prefer playing without waiting for other participants? Explore our digital table and card games powered by random number generators (RNG), where you can play at your own pace.

Among the roulette variations are Roulette Multiplier Spin and Lucky Roulette 1000x, featuring additional multipliers. These add extra possibilities to the familiar format, with rules, betting limits and payout tables available before you start.

Sports Betting at RossoWin

Switch from slots to sporting events without transferring funds between separate accounts. We've brought casino games and our sportsbook together under one shared balance, so you can move between gaming and sports betting with ease. Pick an event, explore the available markets and build your bet slip.

One of our sportsbook's standout features is Early Payout. It allows an eligible winning bet to be settled before the sporting event finishes, provided the promotion's conditions are met. The feature applies only to selected events and markets, with the exact early settlement criteria set out in the promotional terms.

Game Providers at RossoWin

We work with leading studios developing original slots with a range of bonus features. Our partners include Playson, BGaming, Hacksaw Gaming, Yggdrasil, Play'n GO and Playtech. Their releases cover classic slot formats, modern reel mechanics and distinctive bonus modes.

ICONIC21, TaDa Gaming and Onlyplay add further game formats and live casino solutions to our collection. The availability of individual titles may vary depending on your country and any restrictions imposed by the provider.

There's more to enjoy beyond individual games. Join our tournaments, including competitions with prize pools of €600,000 and €25,000. Scoring and prize distribution rules vary by tournament. You can find the details of these events and other bonus offers and promotions in our dedicated section.

How to Start Playing at RossoWin

To get started, create an account, enter your personal details and add funds to your balance. Registration is available to players aged 18 or over in permitted countries, subject to any higher local age requirements. Already registered? Simply log in to your account using your existing details. Creating a second account is not permitted.

Deposits and Withdrawals at RossoWin

Top up your balance using a bank card, e-wallet or another payment method available in your country. The minimum and maximum deposit amounts appear in the cashier once you've selected your payment method. We only accept payments from personal cards and accounts registered in the account holder's name.

Withdraw your winnings through the cashier once your identity has been verified. We use the same payment method as your initial deposit, and your withdrawal amount must fall within the applicable limits. Here's a quick look at our main payment conditions.

Parameter

Conditions

Deposit turnover

Minimum 1x before withdrawal

Withdrawal processing

Up to 3 working days

Minimum and maximum withdrawal

Depends on the payment method

Withdrawal limits

Daily, weekly and monthly limits apply under the cashier rules

Fees and currency conversion

Depend on the payment method and financial intermediaries

After we approve your withdrawal, your bank or payment provider may need additional time to credit the funds. Larger winnings are subject to the applicable withdrawal limits, and amounts exceeding the monthly limit may be paid in instalments.

Identity Verification and KYC at RossoWin

We verify player identities through our Know Your Customer (KYC) process to help protect accounts and monitor financial transactions. Have your documents ready with up-to-date details and clear photographs. The main verification requirements are outlined below.

Verification

RossoWin Requirements

Mandatory KYC

Lifetime deposits exceeding €2,000, any withdrawal request or a suspicious transaction

Proof of identity

Passport, national ID card or driving licence, valid for at least another 3 months

Identity confirmation

Selfie holding your identity document

Proof of address

Bank statement or utility bill issued within the last 3 months

Source of funds

Deposits exceeding €5,000 trigger additional source-of-funds checks

The name on your documents must match your account details, and all required information in the photographs must be clearly readable. If automated verification cannot confirm your identity, we may request additional documents or review them manually.

Source-of-funds checks may require evidence of employment income, business activity or another source of funds. If your KYC verification is unsuccessful, our support team will open a ticket explaining the reason. Once you've provided the correct documents, we'll review your details again. Certain transactions may remain restricted until verification is complete.

mainEntity.name: Can I Create More Than One Account at RossoWin?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We allow only one personal account per player. Multiple accounts may be blocked, and payouts may be cancelled in accordance with our casino rules.

mainEntity.name: Are All Games Available in My Country?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Some slots and live casino games may be subject to regional restrictions. Availability depends on the game provider's rules and your location.

mainEntity.name: Can I Withdraw Winnings to a Friend's or Family Member's Card?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Deposits and withdrawals are permitted only through payment methods registered in your own name. Using another person's bank card or e-wallet is prohibited.

mainEntity.name: Can I Be Asked to Complete KYC Again?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We may request updated documents if we need to carry out additional checks on your identity, payment details or transactions.

mainEntity.name: What Happens if I Don't Use My Account for a Long Time?

acceptedAnswer.text: After 12 months of inactivity, we may charge a €10 monthly administration fee while your account has a positive balance. Charges stop when you reactivate your account or your balance reaches zero.

mainEntity.name: How Can I Set Gambling Limits or Block My Account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact our support team to request self-exclusion. We support responsible gambling and encourage you to set personal limits on the time and money you spend playing.
